notes.title: Mostly Intense Monster Defense launches on Steam on the 2nd of September!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35421079/873b3ddff41c40f805ea199e66cd4a75c71a62a3.png[/img]

Hey potential commanders of the moldy monster dungeon army,

Mostly Intense Monster Defense [b]releases on the 2nd of September![/b] I've worked my solo developer butt off to bring you the best Monster Defense experience I can offer. I got a lot of requests for an endless mode and I'm happy to announce that I managed to add it into the launch build as well!

The game will launch with a price tag of $4.99 and a small discount. 

I guess that's all, enjoy the game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1116430/
